issues.message: alp-sdk root is unresolved. Use --sdk-root, place the project near an alp-sdk checkout, or get an alp-sdk checkout (`git clone https://github.com/alplabai/alp-sdk`), then point tan at it with `--sdk-root <path>`. Neither `--sdk-root`, the project pin `__WORKDIR__/.alp/sdk-path` nor the global default `__HOME__/.alp/sdk-default` named a usable checkout, and none was found at `__WORKDIR__`, `__WORKDIR__/alp-sdk`, `__WORKPARENT__/alp-sdk`, `__WORKPARENT__/alp-sdk-upstream` or in a directory above `__WORKDIR__`.
